name: Miami-Dade County Department of Solid Waste Management
notes: Kept on the catalog municipal-portal family. Researched from the public miamidade.gov Solid Waste Online Fee Payment service page and the public Solid Waste Online Payment System sign-in page (Customer Login with Email address and Password, Password Help, Pay Solid Waste Fees without signing in, Pay Landscaper Visits without signing in); never signed in or started a payment (the site uses reCAPTCHA). Customers who receive a DSWM bill or invoice can pay waste collection service fees, bulky waste overage fees, additional cart fees and landscaper visits online with Visa, Mastercard, American Express or Discover, with no convenience charge (methods card only, fees 0). Liens, fines, delinquency fees and citations cannot be paid online. Pay by mail or in person per the bill: Billing Unit, 2525 NW 62nd Street, 5th Floor, Miami, FL 33147, Monday-Friday 8 a.m.-5 p.m.; Solid Waste Billing 305-594-1630. Most residential waste fees are billed on the property tax bill; this system serves customers who receive a DSWM bill. AutoPay and paperless billing are not offered on the public pages (unsupported, inferred). The guest lookup fields of the pay-without-signing-in form were not observed (family default).

sources.title: Solid Waste Online Fee Payment - Miami-Dade County

pay_online.note: Pay waste collection service fees, bulky waste pickup overage fees, additional cart fees and landscaper visits online. Liens, fines, delinquency fees and citations cannot be paid online.

guest_pay.note: Use Pay Solid Waste Fees to pay without signing in.

autopay.note: Automatic payments are not available in the Solid Waste Online Payment System. Pay each bill online, by mail or in person at 2525 NW 62nd Street, 5th Floor, Miami. Questions: Solid Waste Billing at 305-594-1630.

paperless.note: Paperless billing is not available online; bills are sent by mail. For billing questions call Solid Waste Billing at 305-594-1630.

payment_arrangement.note: Payment plans are not offered online. Call Solid Waste Billing at 305-594-1630, Monday to Friday 8 a.m. to 5 p.m.

cancel_service.note: Waste collection service is not stopped online. Call Solid Waste Billing at 305-594-1630, Monday to Friday 8 a.m. to 5 p.m.

help.title: Paying solid waste fees online
paragraphs: If you receive a bill or invoice from the Department of Solid Waste Management, you can pay it online: waste collection service fees, bulky waste pickup overage fees, additional cart fees and landscaper visits.
Visa, Mastercard, American Express and Discover are accepted, and there is no convenience charge for paying online. Liens, fines, delinquency fees and citations cannot be paid online.

You can also pay by mail or in person; see your bill. The Billing Unit is at 2525 NW 62nd Street, 5th Floor, Miami, FL 33147, open Monday to Friday 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. (closed on County holidays). Solid Waste Billing: 305-594-1630.

extra.intent: Using Miami-Dade DSWM's help pages, find which kinds of charges cannot be paid online. Do not make a payment or change any settings.

solution.text: Liens, fines, delinquency fees and citations cannot be paid online.
